description.p: Bivouac turns cybersecurity competition material into something you can practise with every day, until the competition.

ul.li: Study packs, one per competition: import a Cybearly "Campo base" manual, open a pack file, or start an empty pack and write your own cards
Chapter recaps, key-concept tables and self-check questions
Spaced-repetition flashcards that make sure every card comes back before the competition day, and a multiple-choice drill
A searchable glossary and command cheatsheet, and the manual itself, opened at the right page

description.p: The interface size set to Automatic is a compact 85% now (the shared toolkit's new standard; 80% and 90% are new choices). Larger sizes stay in Settings.
The interface size set to Automatic is the system's own size again (100%); the shared toolkit had made it 115%, which was too big. Larger sizes stay one choice away in Settings.

The look now comes from the suite's shared toolkit (the school's blue and red kept): darker text and firmer borders, larger captions, High contrast mode, and an interface size that is a little larger by default.
The interface is translated into Italian and Russian, with a Language setting. Study content stays in the pack's language.
Pressing Enter in a one-line box now finishes with it: the cursor stops blinking and the box lets go of the focus.
Fixed: opening the app put a second icon on the dock instead of using the pinned one (the screen-size check forgot the app's desktop name).
Choose the interface size, and the window, Settings and editors now fit small screens.
Digest: the whole manual boiled down to takeaways and key terms, to skim and search.
First release: study packs, chapter recaps, spaced-repetition flashcards, multiple-choice drill, glossary, cheatsheet and the manual in a built-in reader.
